notes: Modified cash basis school district; no enterprise funds (School Nutrition is a governmental fund here), so business_type null. Receipts/disbursements/balances from Exhibit III Total Governmental Funds column (pp5-12; statement right-hand columns on pp6, 8, 10, 12); beginning/ending cash = modified cash basis fund balance (p10), equals Statement of Net Position (p1: cash and deposits 1,211,873.74 + county treasurers' balance 495,091.52). Balance sheet (attempt 3, user rule 2026-10-27) from the governmental funds statement of modified cash basis assets and fund balances, Total Governmental Funds column (p12: Assigned 751,416.44, Unassigned 955,548.82), whose totals equal the government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1, Unrestricted 1,706,965.26); no liabilities line printed on p12. County Treasurers' Balance is cash held by the county treasurer (Schedule A-1 p13), so Cash and Cash Equivalents. Local Receipts 2,688,460.73 split by fund column (General, Activities, Special Building on p5-6) using Schedule A (p14) and Schedule I (p22) lines (split_from): property tax, Penalties and Interest on Taxes (1140, separate), motor vehicle, Carline Tax, Public Power District Sales Tax, Rentals, license fees, Activities Fund activity receipts (Extracurricular Receipts). County Receipts 11,432.02 split from Schedule A p14 into 2110 County Fines and License Fees (Fines and Licenses) and 2210 Educational Service Unit (ESU Receipts). State Receipts 3,381,942.15 split from Schedule A p14, Schedule I p22 and Schedule G p20 into state aid 1,853,405.31, Homestead Exemption 38,995.55, Property Tax Credit 1,285,382.07, Nameplate Capacity Tax 194,152.86 and Motor Vehicle Pro-Rate 10,006.36. Vehicle Operation, Maintenance & Purchasing (code 2650, 1,557.99) is Building and Grounds (2600 series). Non-Revenue Receipts 289,062.48 includes 250,000 Depreciation Fund 'Allocation from General Fund' (see attempt 5). Detail: General Fund revenue from Schedule A (pp14-15); General Fund expenditures from Schedule M (object detail, pp23-31) rather than Schedule B (by program, pp16-17) to avoid double counting; Schedule A-1 (p13) summary not itemized. Schedule M blank-actual lines with budget only (Sched A 3599 State Categorical Grants; 1200 Other Items; 3535 PPTS) omitted. Object mapping: Purchased Property Services -> repairs and maintenance, Other Property Services -> professional/contract services, Property -> equipment purchases, Other Items -> dues, training and travel (judgement). Transfers in detail are section other financing with sign; General Fund Schedule A/M totals include them. Transfers: General fund 60,000 out (45,000 Activities, 15,000 Nutrition), Bond fund 317,783.13 out to General; total 377,783.13 in/out nets to zero. Attempt 4 (2026-10-28 verifier fixes): receipt 1910 Rentals split line -> category Rentals; Nutrition 1620 Non Reimbursable -> School Lunch Sales (part of Sales of Meals 65,533.71 p6); Sched M program lines follow the report's grouping (user 2026-10-28): 3535 High Ability Learners and 3551 Career Education -> State Categorical Programs (statement State Programs 106,603.72 p10 = 5,203.97 + 3,914.75 + 97,485.00, Sched B p17), 6200/6310/6406/6408/6990/6992 -> Federal Programs (statement Federal Programs 224,926.07 p10, Sched B p17). Attempt 5 (2026-10-29 audit re-check): the Depreciation Fund 5200 'Allocation from General Fund' 250,000 (Schedule C p18) is an interfund allocation, not revenue. It uses code 5200, the transfer code the Activities/Nutrition 'Transfers from General Fund' lines also use, and the Depreciation Fund's cash in bank rose by it (152,761.14 + 4,864.63 interest + 250,000 = 407,625.77). It is moved out of receipts: Non-Revenue Receipts is now the General Fund 5690 Other Non-Revenue Receipts 39,062.48 (p15; split_from the p6 line), and transfers_in = 377,783.13 + 250,000 = 627,783.13. The General Fund prints no 250,000 transfer (8000 Transfers 60,000 only, p31), so its outflow sits inside an unidentified General Fund disbursement line. Every printed line is kept as printed, with one contra disbursement -250,000 (review), and transfers_out = 377,783.13 + 250,000 = 627,783.13. Detail: Sched C allocation is now an other-financing Transfers In (+250,000; the revenue total includes other financing); Sched M has a contra expenditure -250,000 and a Transfers Out -250,000. Printed totals are unchanged (reported_totals includes_split 250,000 on both sides). Read pages 1-31 of 31.

decision_needed.question: The Depreciation Fund received 250,000 '5200 Allocation from General Fund' (p18), but no General Fund line shows the matching outflow (8000 Transfers only 60,000, p31). Which General Fund disbursement line holds it, so the contra can be placed on that line?
decision_needed.recorded_as: transfers_in/transfers_out +250,000 each; contra disbursement -250,000 (category other, review) against the unidentified General Fund line
